name: rn
description: Give a goal, roughly: rn works out with you what you really want, plans to your next decision on a draft PR, and carries the work through — one agent implements each task, another evaluates it — calling you back only for decisions that are yours (/rn:ty approve, /rn:gm revise). The session lives in git, so it resumes across conversations (/rn:dn, /rn:up).
